abstract: The main flatness conjecture for $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{C})$-Fock bundles predicts the existence of a unique strongly positive flat compatible Hermitian metric for every $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{C})$-Fock bundle. We use cyclic Higgs bundles to disprove this conjecture for every rank $n \geq 3.$
hook: A conjecture on flat metrics for Fock bundles is false in every rank 3 or higher.
hook_turn: false in every rank 3 or higher.
summary: The main flatness conjecture predicted a unique strongly positive flat compatible Hermitian metric for every SL_n(C) Fock bundle. Using cyclic Higgs bundles, the author builds counterexamples for every rank n of at least 3. The result is highly specialized and says nothing about rank 2.
title: A counterexample on the main flatness conjecture for $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{C})$-Fock bundles
